insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (varies as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Restore / Refill Benefit (unlimited, same illness allowed) — “Binge Refill”
great.quote: If the Policy Sum Insured along with accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), Super No Claim Bonus (if any), is completely exhausted or is insufficient for covering a claim as a result of previous claims, then We shall provide for a refill of the Sum Insured, unlimited times during the Policy Year... The Refill of Sum Insured shall be available for all subsequent claims also and to any Illness / Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted
great.explanation: Once your base SI (and bonuses) is used up, the insurer refills SI unlimited times in the same policy year, and it can be used even for the same illness/complications (subject to conditions and per-claim max = base SI).

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer after exhaustion (refill activates after base+bonuses are exhausted) — “Binge Refill”
great.quote: If the Policy Sum Insured along with accumulated No Claim Bonus (if any), Super No Claim Bonus (if any), is completely exhausted... then We shall provide for a refill of the Sum Insured, unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: This is an in-built extra SI layer that activates after your available limit is exhausted, reducing the risk of running out of cover mid-year.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period: 30 days (standard)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Non-accident illnesses are not covered in the first 30 days from start. Accidents are covered.

good.name: Specific Illness / Procedure Waiting Period: 24 months (standard)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with Us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 (Code-Excl02) Specified disease / procedure waiting period
good.explanation: Listed illnesses/procedures are covered only after completing 24 months of continuous coverage (unless due to accident).

good.name: NCB / Renewal Bonus available (but reduces on claim) — 10% per claim-free year up to 100%
good.quote: We shall apply a cumulative bonus in the form of No Claim Bonus at such 10% of the Sum Insured of the expiring policy year... The accumulated No Claim Bonus shall not exceed 100% of the Sum Insured... In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by the percentage of Sum Insured as accumulated in the previous Policy Year
good.explanation: Sum Insured can increase by 10% each claim-free year (up to 100%). However, a claim reduces the accumulated bonus (i.e., it is a resetting/reducing style bonus).

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization covered
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred for the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the Sum Insured as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
good.explanation: If hospitalization-type treatment is taken at home due to medical necessity or non-availability of hospital bed, expenses can be covered (subject to conditions).

bad.name: Room Rent limit exists (not “any room/no limit”) and can cause proportionate deduction (room rent is as per schedule)
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent for accommodation in Hospital room and other boarding charges up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy;
bad.explanation: Room eligibility is capped as per your plan/schedule (not at actuals by default). If you choose a higher room category than eligible, proportional deductions can apply to associated medical expenses.

bad.name: Consumables not explicitly covered as a separate benefit (assume not covered per instruction)
bad.quote: Medicines, drugs and other allowable consumables prescribed by the treating Medical Practitioner;
bad.explanation: The wording mentions “allowable consumables” within inpatient expenses, but there is also a policy structure where non-medical items are generally excluded unless an optional waiver is taken. Since the document does not clearly confirm full consumables coverage without exclusions/caps, this is treated as not covered for the mandatory ‘Consumables’ feature and should be verified in the Product Benefit Table/Annexure.

bad.name: NCB reduces after claim (bonus is not protected / non-resetting)
bad.quote: In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by the percentage of Sum Insured as accumulated in the previous Policy Year
bad.reference: Section C.II (l) (I).a No Claim Bonus, Condition (xi)
bad.explanation: A claim reduces accumulated NCB. Better policies keep the renewal bonus intact even after claims.
